MINUTES
  SPECIAL PARK AND ACTIVTIES COMMISSION MEETING
  NOVEMBER 8, 2017

  A special meeting of the Park and Activities Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was
  called to order at 5:30 p.m. at the City of Rolling Hills Estates Council Chambers, 4045 Palos
  Verdes Drive North, Rolling Hills Estates, California by CHAIR POPE.

  2.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  CHAIR POPE led those in attendance in the Pledge of Allegiance.

  3.  ROLL CALL

  COMMISSIONERS PRESENT:Chair Pope, Romanelli, Giglia, Persichina, Portugal, Retz

  COMMISSIONERS ABSENT: Wroan

  STAFF PRESENT:  Andy Clark, Community Services Director
  Doug Prichard, City Manager

  4.  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION DRAFT MINUTES OF AUGUST 21, 2017
  None

  5.  AUDIENCE ITEMS
  None

  6.  CONSENT CALENDAR
  None

  7.  BUSINESS ITEMS

  A.  DAPPLEGRAY POA STREET ENTRYWAY BEAUTIFICATION PROGRAM PROJECT
  FUNDING REQUEST.

  Commissioner Retz and Commissioner Persichina recused themselves from this item.

  Community Services Director Clark provided a brief summary of the staff report for this item.
  The proposal is to improve the landscaping on both sides of the entryway.

  Community Services Director Clark stated that staff recommends that the Park and Activities
  Commission approve the Dapplegray lanes Property Owner Association’s request of $2,500
  in matching funds from the City’s street entryway program in 2017-2018.

  COMMISSIONER GIGLIA asked if there would be any change to the marquee.

  Kirk Retz, Dapplegray HOA, replied that there no changes to the marquee.

  COMMISSIONER GIGLIA MADE A MOTION, SECONDED BY COMMISSIONER
  ROMANELLI,

  TO APPROVE STAFF’S RECOMMENDATION TO APPROVE STAFF’S
  RECOMMENDATION AND APPROVE THE DAPPLEGRAY LANES PROPERTY
  OWNER ASSOCIATION’S REQUEST OF $2,500 IN MATCHING FUNDS FROM THE
  CITY’S STREET ENTRYWAY PROGRAM.

  AYES:  Chair Pope, Romanelli, Giglia, Portugal
  NAYES:
  ABSENT: Wroan
  ABSTAIN:
  RECUSE: Retz, Persichina

SPECIAL MEETING PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION  1
MEETING MINUTES
NOVEMBER 8, 2017
   B. CHADMAR GROUP AND ROLLING HILLS COUNTRY CLUB RIGHT-OF-WAY SIGN
  REQUESTS.

  Community Services Director Clark provided a brief summary of the request by the Rolling
  Hills Country Club and stated that staff recommends that the Park and Activities Commission
  approve the installation of two Sign B street name monument signs where shown on the map
  with the following specifications: (a) the size of Sign B shall be 4 feet tall by 5 feet wide; (b)
  the sign facing south bound traffic shall include a right-turn arrow; and (c) the signs shall be
  installed by City staff in the road right-of-way sites designated by the Traffic Engineer.

  COMMISSIONER PORTUGAL stated that a correction will need to be made to the description
  on the sign rendering, from burgundy/black to white background with green lettering.
  Community Services Director Clark stated that it is a typo and will be corrected.

  Bruce Steckel, Rolling Hills Country Club, stated that the proposal is for a permanent sign
  which will be in the public right-of-way and will direct visitors to Chandler Ranch Road. Mr.
  Steckel stated that he is suggesting that the northbound and southbound signs be placed on
  the east side of the road. In addition, for southbound traffic, an arrow to let drivers know that
  a right turn is coming up will likely be needed.

  COMMISSIONER RETZ asked if the Traffic Engineer has commented on moving the sign to
  the east side of the road. Community Services Clark stated that it will need to be reviewed
  prior to final approval by staff.

  Mr. Steckel requested that the Rolling Hills Country Club be allowed to include their logo on
  the sign. COMMISSIONER GIGLIA expressed his opposition for the request of adding the
  logo.

  COMMISSIONER PORTUGAL made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER GIGLIA
  to,

  APPROVE STAFF’S RECOMMENDATION WITH THE CONDITION THAT (1) THE
  TRAFFIC ENGINEER ASSESS AND APPROVE THE INSTALLATION OF THE
  STREET MONUMENT SIGN FOR SOUTHBOUND TRAFFIC ON THE EAST SIDE
  OF THE STREET. (2) CORRECT THE DESCRIPTION REGARDING COLOR ON
  THE SIGN RENDERING.

  THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR POPE SO ORDERED.

  Community Services Director Clark provided a brief summary of the request by The Chadmar
  Group and stated that staff recommends that the Park and Activities Commission approve the
  installation of a temporary, two-sided Sign C monument sign promoting new home sales with
  the following specifications: (a) The burgundy and white coloring on Sign C shall be reversed;
  (b) The size of Sign C shall be 6 feet tall by 8 feet wide; and (c) The sign shall be installed by
  City staff in the road right-of-way site designated by the Traffic Engineer.

  The Park and Activities Commission held a discussion on the color options for the sign.

  Chuck Lande, The Chadmar Group, that the theme of the artwork for the “for sale” signs will
  be consistent throughout.

  COMMISSIONER GIGLIA made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI to,

  APPROVE STAFF’S RECOMMENDATION WITH THE COLOR TO BE APPROVED
  ACCORDING TO WHAT IS PROPOSED BY THE APPLICANT AND THE SIZE TO
  BE APPROVED AS RECOMMENDED BY STAFF.

  AYES:  Romanelli, Giglia
  NAYES: Chair Pope, Persichina, Portugal, Retz
  ABSENT: Wroan
  ABSTAIN:

  Motion failed

SPECIAL MEETING PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION  2
MEETING MINUTES
NOVEMBER 8, 2017
   COMMISSIONER PORTUGAL made a motion seconded by COMMISSIONER RETZ to,

  APPROVE STAFF’S RECOMMENDATION APPROVE THE INSTALLATION OF A
  TEMPORARY, TWO-SIDED SIGN C MONUMENT SIGN PROMOTING NEW HOME
  SALES WITH THE FOLLOWING SPECIFICATIONS: (A) THE BURGUNDY AND
  WHITE COLORING ON SIGN C SHALL BE REVERSED; (B) THE SIZE OF SIGN C
  SHALL BE 6 FEET TALL BY 8 FEET WIDE; AND (C) THE SIGN SHALL BE
  INSTALLED BY CITY STAFF IN THE ROAD RIGHT-OF-WAY SITE DESIGNATED
  BY THE TRAFFIC ENGINEER.

  AYES:  Chair Pope, Persichina, Portugal, Retz
  NAYES: Romanelli, Giglia
  ABSENT: Wroan
  ABSTAIN:

  Motion passed

  8. ADJOURNMENT

  CHAIR POPE adjourned the meeting at 5:55 pm to the regular Park & Activities Commission
  meeting of November 20, 2017 at 7:00 p.m. at the City of Rolling Hills Council Chamber, 4045
  Palos Verdes Drive North, Rolling Hills Estates, CA 90274.
